items.t: Jefferies Analyst Slams Simple-Minded Criticism of SpaceX Governance
items.d: Investors who blacklist Space Exploration Technologies Corp. out of governance qualms are too hung up on box-checking and risk depriving themselves of long-term financial gains, according to Aniket Shah of Jefferies.
items.takeaway: SpaceX 경영 비판이 반박돼 우주 산업 투자 심리 개선

items.t: Inversion Space is testing orbital cargo for faster global deliveries
items.d: One company thinks taking a shortcut through space can get allow 45-minute flights anywhere on Earth, while also aiding U.S. missile defense. NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz reports on how Inversion, a Southern California space company, is planning to move supplies around the globe by sending cargo into orbit and letting come down by parachute.
items.fullText: Distracted driver slams into car during traffic stop
items.takeaway: Inversion Space의 궤도 화물 실험으로 우주 물류 성장 기대
